# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 19 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Supply & Land Sales

- **Up to 2,550 private homes proposed for Kallang Distripark** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that would redevelop the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of potentially more than 2,000 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT station. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

- **Two new GLS sites in Marina South and Orchard Boulevard could add around 500 homes** - URA released two Government Land Sales sites — Marina Gardens Lane (6,007.4 sqm) and Orchard Boulevard (3,438.0 sqm) — that together could add around 500 private homes to Singapore's housing pipeline. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/two-new-gls-sites-released-in-marina-south-and-orchard-boulevard/)

## New Private Home Sales

- **Developer sales rebounded to a 3-month high in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from June's 156 units, making it the strongest sales month since April as fresh launches returned after an unusually quiet June. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale prices fell in Q2 2026 while private condo prices rose, widening the upgrader gap** - The HDB resale price index declined in Q2 2026 while private condo prices moved higher, pulling the two markets in opposite directions and increasing the price gap that upgraders must bridge. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-prices-are-falling-while-condo-prices-rise-but-upgraders-have-a-bigger-problem/)

- **A 3-room HDB flat in Clementi sold for a record $896,000** - A unit at 464B Clementi Avenue 1 (Clementi Peaks) changed hands for $896,000, setting a new town record that beats the previous high by $56,000, on one of the block's highest floors. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/3-room-hdb-flat-clementi-sold-for-record-896k-blocks-first-resale/)
